column3: Kuroneko Route · Offering to Kuroneko
So, in the end, you couldn't get Kuroneko on the phone yesterday?
Yeah. I'm not good at leaving voice messages, so I got a little nervous.
Wouldn't Kuroneko-san be disappointed as well? Hasn't it been a while since you've last called her?
The way you're putting it, it's as if I'm dating Kuroneko.
I thought I told you in Kyoto that it isn't like that.
Still, you're worried about her, aren't you?
Well... just a bit.
But, ever since that matter with the 'curse'... Kuroneko's attitude towards me hasn't changed at all.
Of course, it's not like I was confessed to either.
Rather, it feels like she's colder than before.
She's just like a cat. I don't understand what's on her mind.
Ah, speak of the devil.
Hmm?
That was... Kuroneko?
Ah, she left... Did she not hear us?
Yeah, probably. It's not surprising if she didn't hear us with so many people around.
Hmm, then why not try calling out to her once more?
I guess so.
Did you call for me, buddy?
Nope.
Ah, Akagi-kun, good morning.
Good morning, Tamura-san.
You're in the way, get lost.
Now now, who would go 'You're in the way, get lost'? I see you're still cold as ever to guys.
I'm starting to behave like my little sister...
I'm busy right now, do you need anything?
Heh, so you saw through me. In fact, my sister...
That doesn't matter right now, we'll talk about it later.
Whaddya mean she doesn't matter?!
I'm not saying your sister doesn't matter! I'm saying I don't have time to listen to a siscon like you go on about his sister!
What, that's it? You should have said so earlier.
You're such a pain in the ass! Ah, look...
Aa-aa-h, Kuroneko already left...
Ah-, was I getting in the way of something?
Geez... whatever.
I'm sorry!
Don't come over here! You're too clingy!
Ahaha. You two get along so well～
I'm a bit envious.
Don't joke about this... This guy is suspected of being a raging homo.
My my, who did you hear this baseless rumor from?
Your sister.
